name: aomi-transact
description: Prepare, review and reconcile user-authorized Aomi transactions through durable Commits, with operational funding checks and explicit receipt/recipient verification.

interface.short_description: Review and reconcile durable Aomi payment Commits
interface.default_prompt: Use $aomi-transact. Verify CLI availability and capabilities, inspect operational funding, review the exact Commit and simulation, then use the authorized signer. Reconcile the original Commit/hash before retrying and verify recipient funds before reporting completion.
